comparisonScores.warning: Scores are relative comparison values, not calibrated probabilities.

qr_code: a QR code or square matrix barcode intended for machine scanning
a black and white two dimensional barcode with finder squares
an image dominated by a scannable QR pattern
plain_text_or_decorative_text: an image dominated by ordinary readable text or a text poster
a text-heavy screenshot with little diagram structure
stylized decorative lettering or a typographic title image
code_screenshot: a screenshot containing source code with syntax highlighting
a code editor or terminal showing programming code
monospaced computer code arranged in indented lines
table: a data table with rows columns headers and cells
a spreadsheet-like grid containing structured values
tabular information organized into aligned rows and columns
chart_or_plot: a chart or mathematical plot with axes and plotted data
a statistical graph with curves bars points legends or axis labels
a quantitative visualization showing trends or numeric relationships
diagram_or_flowchart: an architecture diagram or flowchart with nodes and arrows
a structured process diagram showing components and relationships
a conceptual technical diagram with connected boxes groups or directions
ui_screenshot: a software user interface screenshot containing panels and controls
an application or web interface with menus buttons forms or status areas
a computer screen capture dominated by interactive interface elements
informative_photo: a photograph of a real scene object device or person that conveys information
a real-world photo whose objects states or relationships may matter
a documentary or explanatory photograph rather than a diagram
decorative_image: a decorative illustration or photograph with little informational content
a visual ornament background or aesthetic image used mainly for decoration
a non-informational scene illustration or filler image
logo_or_icon: a logo emblem isolated brand mark or application icon
a simple symbolic mark used for branding or identification
an isolated logo badge icon or watermark graphic
other_or_uncertain: an ambiguous mixed image that does not clearly match one visual category
an unusual image whose primary visual type is uncertain
a mixed-content visual requiring human inspection to categorize

local_qr: a QR barcode that should be sent to a deterministic local QR decoder
a scannable square matrix code suitable for local barcode decoding
an image whose main machine-readable content is a QR code
local_ocr: a primarily textual image suitable for local optical character recognition
a text poster or plain text screenshot that mainly needs transcription
an image where reading ordinary text is the main processing need
cloud_code: a programming code screenshot requiring careful code transcription
source code whose indentation and exact symbols need specialized processing
a code editor or terminal image that should be handled as code
cloud_structured_visual: a complex diagram chart table or interface requiring structured visual understanding
a visual with layout relationships axes cells nodes or arrows that OCR alone cannot preserve
a technical structured image requiring combined text and spatial reasoning
cloud_visual_description: a meaningful real-world photo or visual scene requiring semantic description
a non-tabular image whose objects states and relationships need visual explanation
an informative scene best represented by a concise visual description
skip_candidate: a decorative image logo watermark or ornament with little retrieval value
a visual that appears mainly decorative or branding-only
a simple non-informational graphic that may be excluded from text retrieval
uncertain: an ambiguous or mixed image that should be reviewed instead of automatically routed
a low-confidence visual whose processing requirement is unclear
an image with conflicting content types requiring human or multimodal review
